title: Kudos to the developers!!!
body:
When I first downloaded Todoist I thought that it will be like any other To-do list. To my surprise, it not only was simpler that other apps but it also had very thoughtful design. Todoist really improved my productivity, now I don’t delay task anymore, completing them on time. Another things I really appreciate is the Karma and Daily/Weekly goals. I feel a sense of accomplishment whenever I hit my Daily/Weekly goal. The Karma really encourages you to complete more task as it rewards you with points. This is one of the best gamification that I have seen in an app. 

Thank you Todoist team for such a wonderful app!
❤️❤️❤️

title: Great for planning and list keeping
body:
I use the app for personal stuff (which includes work) and it’s been super helpful in compartmentalizing all the billion things to remember and keep track of. 

Reminders and filters facilitate browsing through many tasks, if these were appropriately labeled. Reminders though could get some boost, as sometimes I can set the reminder “30 min before start” of the task, but other times I see only an option to type in a specific date and time. 

What would be really helpful is integration with a calendar or visualization of complex projects progress in a Gannt chart. 

Overall, highly recommend, but also looking forward to future feature updates.

title: Overall useful to do management
body:
Clean generally consistent interface. Still sometimes having issues syncing. Some random  child tasks becoming orphan or have 'new parents'.

Calendar scheduling is becoming better by he day. Great work! I like the ability to be able to easily reschedule even the recurring schedules. Used to be painful. 

The biggest gripe is I have extensive todos in my projects. Creating a new task and assigning them under the correct parent is the most frustrating activity on smartphone app. Slowly scrolling through the list looking for the needle in the haystack. A type and match the best match would be really helpful. 

Same goes when I need to change the child task to a different parent.
